_: The village kit's colour sheets repainted in the painted style (realm/tools/kit_paint.py; docs/research/quality-deep-dive.md #5; North Star docs/art/target/01-town.jpg): painted from each sheet's own normal map, so the trim bands stay pixel-aligned. on: the game draws them (else --kit-paint=painted|kit). Per sheet over the defaults: contrast (value steps round the sheet's middle), hue (the material's target colour) and hue_mix (how far toward it), saturation, light (the top light's direction in the sheet's tangent space: +Y is the texture's up), warm and cool (the lit and shaded tints), light_gain and shade_gain, groove (how dark the grooves between tiles and stones; groove_gain, curv_blur), edge (the steep sides; steep_gain), crest (the painted highlight on the crests; crest_gain). Re-run the tool after a change; the game reads realm/assets/village/painted/.
